hyperparameters.terminal_inventory: Residual quantities remain marked at final available close; no assumed free liquidation

cost_assumptions.cost_booking: Once per fill; buy base fee net receipt at fillmid, sell quote fee; gross order spread/slippage; no fee discount

registration_start.reason_for_next_experiment: Create actual fair simple-strategy net-return/risk/cost comparison before new model research

limitations: Minute open OHLC fills and previous-minute volume capacity are proxies, not historical BBO/queue proof
Fixed fees, lot filters and latency are research assumptions; no account keys or orders
All strategies share unchanged capital, cost, caps and causal risk rules, not identical realized risk
Risk scaling occurs only at compressed intent changes; passive price drift may exceed target caps and must be disclosed
VM EWMA uses fixed .3/.3 gross reference basket, not recursive gross strategy NAV
Terminal forced zero target has common latency/cost; minimum lots or capacity may leave marked residuals
Public1h/2h candles and COIN funding/risk/execution are adaptations, not native Jesse full-balance simulation
December2025-February2026 were previously consumed by A05/A06; this is later-development chronology SCREENING, not unseen OOS
Three monthly NAV boundaries retain cash and marked inventory continuously; only final terminal liquidation is common
No new model, timeframe, cost tier, threshold search, or locked March2026 data
Data venue remains Binance; Bybit native prices, filters and regional/account fees unverified
2026 public Bybit fees used as fixed counterfactual, not proven historical account fee
Native inventory contains positive sublot dust; marked terminal residuals never deleted
Gross diagnostic uses same NET_RECEIVED position deltas; not fee-free gross order inventory
Official daily close availability is an exclusive-close proxy; no actual publication certification.
Daily signal data never supplies execution prices or minute risk; existing native-fee minute proxy account is reused.
Three accounts begin fresh-flat and are not stitched into a common CAGR or an unseen validation.

received_mid = mid * (1 - config.fee_rate) if side == 'buy' else mid
cost_per_quantity = fill - received_mid if side == 'buy' else abs(fill - mid) + fill * config.fee_rate

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: desired_quantity = abs(desired_dollars) / (mid + weight * cost_per_quantity if side == 'buy' else mid - weight * cost_per_quantity)
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: desired_quantity = abs(desired_dollars) / (received_mid + weight * cost_per_quantity if side == 'buy' else mid - weight * cost_per_quantity)

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: asset_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_weight * nav - positions[symbol] * mid) / (mid + config.max_weight * cost_per_quantity))
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: asset_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_weight * nav - positions[symbol] * mid) / (received_mid + config.max_weight * cost_per_quantity))

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: gross_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_gross * nav - gross) / (mid + config.max_gross * cost_per_quantity))
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: gross_limit = max(0.0, (config.max_gross * nav - gross) / (received_mid + config.max_gross * cost_per_quantity))

allowed_ast_changes.old_statement: quantity = min(quantity, cash / (fill * (1 + config.fee_rate)), asset_limit, gross_limit)
allowed_ast_changes.new_statement: quantity = min(quantity, cash / fill, asset_limit, gross_limit)

cash_delta, position_delta, fee_asset, fee_amount, fee_USDT_mid = _received_asset_fill(symbol, side, quantity, fill, mid, config.fee_rate)
fee = fee_USDT_mid

if positions[symbol] < 0:
    raise AssertionError('Received-asset settlement cannot oversell net spot inventory')
